h1: The 8 Best Wood File Cabinets Under $200 in 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Wood File Cabinets Under $200: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 wood file cabinets under $200, scored on locks, full-extension slides, casters, anti-tip design and file drawer capacity.
summary: The DEVAISE 2-drawer cabinet with individual locks is the best wood file cabinet under $200, with ball-bearing full-extension slides, a deep hanging-file drawer and an anti-tip caster. The DEVAISE 3-drawer lock model is the capacity pick, the Panana 2-drawer is the best value in three colours, and the Panana 3-drawer is the cheapest storage-first option.
intro: Under $200 the first thing to look at is not the wood, it is whether the cabinet can tip. A rolling file cabinet is a tall, narrow box, and the moment a top drawer is open and loaded, the centre of gravity moves forward. The cabinets that stay upright have a fifth caster under the bottom drawer, and the ones that do not are an accident waiting to happen next to a child or a pet.

So this ranking leads with stability, then slides, locks and filing capacity. We reviewed eight cabinets from their listings and specifications, comparing drawer count, rail adjustability, slide type, lock layout, caster design and the weight figures a maker is willing to print. We did not test any cabinet physically, and every cabinet here costs well below $200, so the cap is rarely the issue.

products.name: DEVAISE 2 Drawer File Cabinet, Wood File Cabinet with Lock, Brown Oak
products.verdict: Ball-bearing slides, a lock on each drawer and a deep bottom drawer, rolling on anti-tip casters.
products.description:
This cabinet pairs a shallower top drawer with a deep bottom drawer that takes hanging files. Each drawer has its own key lock, the slides are full-extension ball-bearing, and it is rated for up to 44 lb. Four 360 degree swivel casters carry it, two with brakes, plus a centre anti-tip caster. It measures 18.11 inches wide, 15.75 deep and 27.28 tall, with a walnut-grain veneer and retro handles, and it costs $50 to $100.

It wins because it is the only model that combines ball-bearing slides, individual locks and a stated weight rating. A published figure of 44 lb is modest, but a printed number beats a vague promise. Against the three-drawer DEVAISE below it gives up one drawer and gains a deeper file drawer.

Buy it for a home office with confidential paperwork and a printer on top. The caveat is that 44 lb is a cap you should respect: a laser printer plus a stack of paper can reach it.
products.idealFor: Home offices with private paperwork and a printer on top.
products.skipIf: You need three drawers of hanging files.

products.name: DEVAISE 3 Drawer Wood File Cabinet with Individual Locks, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: Three keyed drawers, silent full-extension slides and a side hook for a bag or headphones.
products.description:
This version adds a third drawer and gives each one its own lock. The big bottom drawer has adjustable hanging rails for Letter, A4 and Legal, the slides are full-extension and quiet, and five casters, two braked, with a fifth anti-tip wheel under the bottom drawer, keep it steady. A side hook holds a bag, and the top handles a home printer. It costs $50 to $100.

It places second because the extra drawer is a real gain for people who keep supplies as well as files, while the listing offers less detail on the slide type than the two-drawer model above. It also gives no weight figure. The Legal-size rail option is the thing that separates it from most of the cheaper cabinets.

It suits shared homes and small offices. It is not the cabinet for someone who wants every drawer to hang files, as only the bottom one has rails.
products.idealFor: Shared homes needing files plus supply storage.
products.skipIf: You want rails and slides detailed in full.

products.name: Panana 2 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet, Wood Rolling Filing Cabinet Printer Stand Under Desk Storage Organizer
products.verdict: Full-extension slides, adjustable hanging bars and three colours at a very low price.
products.description:
The Panana 2-drawer is about 16.1 inches wide, 15.7 deep and 28.5 tall, with two drawers for A4 and Letter files, full-extension slides and adjustable hanging bars that let you change the format. Five wheels include two braked front casters and an extra wheel under the bottom drawer against tipping. It comes in black, white or a wood finish, and costs $50 to $100.

Third place follows from the lack of a lock. The slides and anti-tip wheel match the DEVAISE models, and the adjustable bars are generous, but without a lock it is a filing cart, not a secure cabinet. It is also tall at roughly 28.5 inches, so measure the gap under your desk.

It is the sensible buy when you want the mechanics of a good rolling cabinet and do not need to lock anything. Check clearance before you order.

products.name: DEVAISE 3 Drawer File Cabinet, Wood Under Desk Filing Cabinet, Walnut
products.verdict: FSC-certified wood, five casters and rails for Letter, A4 and Legal in the bottom drawer.
products.description:
The listing names FSC-certified wood with a scratch and stain resistant surface. It stands 25.2 inches tall including wheels, 18.2 wide and 15.6 deep, with five casters, two of them braked, and a middle caster so the cabinet does not tip when every drawer is open. The bottom drawer takes hanging files in three sizes, and the cabinet also doubles as a rolling printer stand. It costs $50 to $100.

Fourth place reflects the missing lock and the thin slide description. Its certified wood and lower height make it the most sensible of the three-drawer models for tight desk clearance, and it undercuts the locking DEVAISE for people who do not need keys.

Choose it when a low profile and sourcing matter. Look elsewhere for security.
products.idealFor: Low desks and buyers who care about wood sourcing.
products.skipIf: You need to lock any drawer.

products.name: 3 Drawers Fluted Mobile File Cabinet with Lock, Rolling File Cabinet Printer Stand Table, Under Desk Wooden File Cabinet
products.verdict: One lock and two keys cover every drawer, on a fluted-front cabinet rated to 100 lb.
products.description:
The fluted fronts give this cabinet a more designed look than the other budget models. An interlock system lets one lock with two keys secure all three drawers, the wheels lock, and the maker states support for up to 100 pounds. The panels are described as eco-friendly wood, with a surface that wipes clean.

It takes fifth place because convenience is the main benefit: one key is easier than three, and a 100 lb figure is the highest on the list. The weakness is that the listing says nothing about hanging rails or file sizes, so filing is an afterthought. It also lacks a stated slide type.

It works as a rolling storage table with a lock. Buy it for a craft room or a bedside, and pick a DEVAISE if documents are the priority.
products.idealFor: Rolling storage with a single lock.

products.name: FATIGOS 2 Drawer File Cabinets, Wood File Cabinet with Hanging Bar for Letter Size, Modern Farmhouse Under Desk
products.verdict: A 24 inch tall farmhouse cabinet with stainless hanging bars and a 55 lb per drawer rating.
products.description:
FATIGOS keeps it small: 15.1 inches wide, 15.7 deep, 24 tall and 32 lb. Each drawer is stated to carry 55 lb, and the reinforced stainless steel hanging rods are meant to resist bending under Letter folders. The wood-grain finish is described as scratch and water resistant, and the top can take a home printer.

Sixth place reflects a sound design with fewer features. There is no lock, no wheels and no Legal support. The drawers are shallow at about 8.9 inches of internal height, so they suit slim folders rather than bulky files.

It suits a small desk where a fixed, stable pedestal is enough. Skip it for confidential papers or anything bulky.

products.name: NICEGDLT 2 Drawer File Cabinet，Wood Filing Cabinets for Home Office, Walnut
products.verdict: Classic X-panel fronts and adjustable rails in both drawers, though ratings go unpublished.
products.description:
The NICEGDLT measures 15.4 inches wide, 15.7 deep and 24 tall. Both drawers have adjustable hanging rails for Letter and A4, the fronts use an X-panel design, and the maker describes the drawer slides as smooth and quiet. The top can serve as a printer stand or a side table. It costs $50 to $100.

It ranks seventh because it matches the FATIGOS on size but publishes no weight limit, no lock and no slide type, which makes it harder to trust. What you pay for is the style, and the rails in both drawers.

Buy it if the cabinet will be seen. Pass on it if you need numbers on the page.

products.name: Panana 3 Drawer Wood Mobile File Cabinet, Under Desk Storage Drawers Small File Cabinet for Home Office (Black)
products.verdict: Honeycomb board and five casters, with two small drawers over a Letter file drawer.
products.description:
The Panana 3-drawer is built from 18mm honeycomb board, which is light and water resistant. Two small drawers sit above a single file drawer that takes hanging Letter folders, and the cabinet rolls on five casters including two locking front wheels and a central anti-tip wheel. It is roughly 24 by 15.7 by 15.7 inches and costs $50 to $100.

It ranks last because only one drawer files documents and only in Letter size. The upside is a lot of cheap, tidy storage for supplies, plus easy movement.

Choose it for a student desk, craft table or kid's room. Pick another model for real filing.

methodology.title: Stability
methodology.description: Anti-tip casters, braked wheels and published dimensions are scored first, because a tall narrow cabinet is a tipping hazard when loaded.

methodology.title: Slide quality
methodology.description: Full-extension and ball-bearing slides score above unspecified runners since they decide how the cabinet feels after a year.

methodology.title: Lock design
methodology.description: Individual locks beat a single shared lock, which beats none, though all of them are light-duty deterrents.

methodology.title: Filing capacity
methodology.description: We count drawers that hold hanging files, the formats named, and whether rails adjust.

methodology.title: Stated limits and finish
methodology.description: Weight ratings, board thickness and certifications are rewarded when printed and marked down when missing.

whatMatters.detail: A fifth caster under the bottom drawer, or a wide base, stops a loaded cabinet falling forward when a top drawer is open. This matters most if you have children or pets, or if you keep the printer on top. Look for the words anti-tip in the description and a pictured fifth wheel.

Ball-bearing slides carry more weight and move more smoothly than simple friction runners, and full-extension versions let you reach the back of a drawer. At this price a maker that names the slide type is usually proud of it. Check the listing for the slide type and for any per-drawer weight rating.

A lock on each drawer lets you secure personal papers and leave the supply drawer open. These are cam locks that stop casual access, not burglars, so use them as a privacy tool. Confirm that every drawer has a lock and that keys are included.

A printed figure such as 44 lb for the cabinet or 55 lb per drawer tells you the maker has an actual limit in mind. A printer and a ream of paper can add up quickly. Add up what will sit on top and compare it with the number before you buy.

Casters add roughly an inch or two. Measure the clearance beneath your desk, subtract a little for the apron, and compare with the cabinet's listed height. A 28 inch cabinet will not fit under a standard 29 inch desk with a drawer in the way.

faq.a: No, they ship flat with labelled parts, and the listings promise a step-by-step manual. Expect about an hour of work with a screwdriver, and recheck the screws after a few weeks.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with rolling cabinets?
faq.a: Leaving the casters unlocked while a drawer is open. Always set the front brakes before pulling a loaded drawer, since the cabinet can roll away or rock forward.

faq.q: Is the DEVAISE with locks worth more than the Panana?
faq.a: If you store anything private, yes. The DEVAISE locks every drawer and states a weight rating, while the Panana 2-drawer has similar slides but no lock. For a plain home filing cart, the Panana is just as good.
Only the two DEVAISE 3-drawer models name Legal support in the bottom drawer. The others list Letter and A4, so measure before buying.

faq.q: How do I keep drawers gliding?
faq.a: Keep the slides free of dust, avoid overloading the top drawer, and use a dry lubricant on metal runners once a year. Ball-bearing slides need less care than basic runners.

faq.q: Do I need a fifth caster?
faq.a: Yes if the cabinet rolls. The fifth wheel under the bottom drawer is the anti-tip device, and every rolling model here includes one.

finalTake: The DEVAISE 2-drawer cabinet with locks is the best wood file cabinet under $200, with ball-bearing slides, a lock on each drawer and a stated 44 lb rating. Step up to the DEVAISE 3-drawer for capacity, take the Panana 2-drawer for the simple value, and keep the Panana 3-drawer for supplies. All eight cost far under the cap, so spend the savings on a decent printer stand and keep the weight low.
